subject: Renewal: Kairos — tiered volume & routing plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@kairos.health>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@kairos.health>
Date: 2027-07-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: renewal numbers + target $/1M

Thanks Jasmine — quick follow-up from this morning's call. Appreciate the walkthrough. A few items we want captured before procurement gets involved so we can budget correctly:

- Forecast (conservative): month 0 (renewal start) = ~30M tokens/mo. Ramp to 150M tokens/mo within 12 months with a few spiky events.
- Workload split (est): chat generation ~70% (latency-sensitive), embeddings ~20% (throughput), reranking/batch ~10%.
- Target economics: our CFO is looking for an effective blended target around $1,150 per 1M tokens (this is our internal target to sign). If you can get us a model + routing plan that lands at or below that blended number at target volumes, we can move fast.
- Routes to add: will want embeddings route pinned to a lower-cost quantized model, chat to standard gen path. Also curious about a blended route for occasional higher-quality outputs (e.g., 13B float) — how that mixes into the blended $/1M.

Can you send a short recap with proposed tiers/step-ups and a target blended $/1M at the 150M token run rate? Also include any assumptions (tokenization, billable definition: input+output) and whether caching/prefix savings assumed.

Attaching our internal forecast for reference: Kairos_Q3_consumption_forecast.xlsx

Thanks,
Sanjay
Head of Product, Kairos Health

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@kairos.health>
Cc: Emily Chen <emily.chen@kairos.health>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: renewal numbers + target $/1M

Sanjay — thanks for the clear notes and the forecast. Recap + next steps below. I've also attached a short pricing workbook that maps the tier math.

Recap (assumptions):
- Billable tokens = input + output (standard Redwood billing).
- Cache/prefix savings: we assume conservative 5% prefix caching on chat; embeddings assumed no cacheable tokens.
- Initial mix: chat 70%, embeddings 20%, rerank/batch 10%.

High-level proposal (illustrative; internal review to follow):
- Target blended: $1,100–$1,250 per 1M tokens at 150M tokens/mo (range depends on exact route mix and allowable model mix). Our target to hit your CFO ask of ~$1,150 is realistic if we: (1) route embeddings to quantized 7B models, (2) use 7B quant/8-bit for non-critical chat and reserve 13B/float for a small percent of high-quality queries.
- Step-up tiers (monthly):
  * 0–50M: list-rate / minimal discount
  * 50–100M: ~10% discount off list per-token
  * 100–250M: ~18–25% off list when blended with routing policies

Concrete ask for Kairos procurement prep: would you confirm the following by EOD?
1) Target blended $/1M to present (you mentioned $1,150)
2) Any hard requirements for model fidelity (e.g., must keep >90% of queries on 13B)
3) Procurement timeline / PO lead time

If that looks good I'll route to pricing (aditya + marissa) to produce a formal stepped quote and a short routing playbook.

Attachments: Kairos_Q3_consumption_forecast.xlsx, redwood_pricing_workbook_v1.xlsx

Best,
Jasmine Liu

Also include proposed contract language for route pinning and a short note on fallback policies (we can auto-fallback to a compatible model if capacity constrained).

I put the forecast in the attachment for your modeling. Let me know if you need a quick sync.

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: renewal numbers + target $/1M — pricing request

Jasmine — thanks. Attached is a succinct proposal and the blended math (Kairos_Proposed_Pricing.pdf). Highlights below so you can present them to Sanjay:

Assumptions recap:
- Billable: input + output tokens
- Cache: 5% assumed on chat, none on embeddings
- Tokenization: BPE; we normalized to canonical 1M token basis

Scenario A — Conservative (keep 40% chat on 13B/float):
- Volumes: 150M tokens/mo (steady-state)
- Suggested volume tiers:
  * 0–50M: $1,450 / 1M tokens (list-heavy)
  * 50–100M: $1,300 / 1M tokens (10% discount)
  * 100–250M: $1,150 / 1M tokens (20% discount blended with route mix)
- Effective blended at 150M (with 40% chat on 13B): ~$1,280 / 1M tokens

Scenario B — Aggressive routing (limit 13B to 10% of chat; majority on quantized 7B):
- Volume tiers same as above but routing adjustments change blend
- Effective blended at 150M: ~$1,110 / 1M tokens (meets their $1,150 target with headroom)

Per-route guidance (for contract):
- embeddings.route -> quantized-7b-8bit (pinned)
- chat.lowcost -> quantized-7b-8bit (preferred)
- chat.highqual -> 13b-float (capped percentage)
- rerank.batch -> 13b-quant (batch pricing)

Other commercial levers:
- Commitment term: 12-month revenue commitment accelerates discounts by ~5 percentage points at 100M+
- Auto-burst: allow 10% burst capacity at list-rate with credits for overages to preserve low blended numbers

Next steps I recommend:
1) Jasmine / Marissa to present Scenario B as our recommended path to hit the $1,150 target.
2) If they signal go, pricing will produce a formal quote PDF and a service route addendum that pins the embeddings route.

Attachments: Kairos_Proposed_Pricing.pdf

- Aditya
Director, Commercial Pricing, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0177

- Procurement sync: can we target next Thursday 2027-07-29 at 10am PT? I'll invite our Proc and Finance leads.

If you can also drop the DocuSign link for the quote / MSA after we align, that would speed things up.

Thanks — moving this to internal procurement this afternoon.

Best,
Sanjay
